## 1.0 Overview

The speech interface transforms the MkDocs platform into a voice-enabled documentation system, allowing users to:

- **Voice Search**: Ask questions using natural speech
- **Hands-Free Navigation**: Control the interface without typing
- **Audio Responses**: Hear answers read aloud with text-to-speech
- **Wake Word Detection**: Activate voice mode with "Aria" commands
- **Continuous Interaction**: Maintain conversational flow with the system
page_texts.4:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#key-features]

### Key Features

- **Natural Language Processing**: Understanding conversational queries
- **Speech Recognition**: Browser-based speech-to-text conversion
- **Audio Feedback**: Distinctive beeps for system state changes
- **Voice Synthesis**: High-quality text-to-speech output
- **State Management**: Sophisticated state machine for interaction flow
- **Browser Optimization**: Specific tuning for Edge and Chrome browsers

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#component-integration]

### Component Integration

The modular speech interface architecture provides several key advantages over the previous monolithic design:
page_texts.8:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#separation-of-concerns]

#### Separation of Concerns

- **Browser Detection**: Isolated compatibility logic with browser-specific optimizations
- **Audio Management**: Dedicated audio handling with specialized TTS and beep generation
- **Voice Recognition**: Focused speech processing with wake word detection
- **State Management**: Clean state machine implementation with transition validation
- **UI Interface**: Separated DOM manipulation and user interaction logic
- **Orchestration**: Centralized coordination without tight coupling

page_texts.10:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#error-handling-and-resilience]

#### Error Handling and Resilience

The modular architecture provides improved error isolation and recovery:

- **Component Failure**: Individual components can fail without affecting others
- **Graceful Degradation**: System automatically falls back to working components
- **Error Propagation**: Controlled error bubbling through orchestrator
page_texts.11:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#naming-convention-and-cache-busting]

#### Naming Convention and Cache Busting

All JavaScript components follow the `search-` prefix naming convention to:

- **Prevent Naming Collisions**: Avoid conflicts with other platform components
- **Improve Organization**: Clear identification of speech interface components
- **Support Cache Busting**: Compatible with existing build system that automatically renames assets with timestamp suffixes
- **Enable Selective Loading**: Components can be loaded independently based on requirements

The speech interface integrates seamlessly with existing platform components:

- **Search Interface**: Voice queries trigger standard search functionality
- **RAG Integration**: Spoken questions processed through AI service
- **UI Components**: Voice controls embedded in chat interface
- **State Management**: Speech state synchronized with application state

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#recognition-configuration]

### Recognition Configuration

| Setting              | Value   | Purpose                           |
| -------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------- |
| **Continuous**       | `true`  | Allows ongoing speech recognition |
| **Interim Results**  | `true`  | Provides real-time transcription  |
| **Language**         | `en-US` | Primary language for recognition  |
| **Max Alternatives** | `1`     | Single best transcription result  |
page_texts.15:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#wake-word-detection]

### Wake Word Detection

The system listens for specific wake words to activate voice interaction:

- **Primary**: `"Aria"`
- **Variants**: `"Hey Aria"`, `"Hello Aria"`
- **Detection**: Case-insensitive, anywhere in transcript
- **Grace Period**: 800ms delay to prevent false activations

- Resource monitoring

**Triggers:**

- Health issues → Recovery

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#56-error-recovery-state-flows]

### 5.6 Error Recovery State Flows

![Mermaid Diagram](assets/mermaid/mermaid-diagram-9455c94d.svg)



<!--
Original Mermaid code:
![Mermaid Diagram](assets/mermaid/mermaid-diagram-9455c94d.svg)


<!--
Original Mermaid code:
```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    AudioInit --> ErrorRecovery : Setup failed
    PassiveListening --> ErrorRecovery : Service failure
    ActiveListening --> ErrorRecovery : Recognition error
    CommandExecution --> ErrorRecovery : Execution error

    state ErrorRecovery {
        [*] --> ClassifyError
        ClassifyError --> TransientError : Temporary issue
        ClassifyError --> ServiceError : Service down
        ClassifyError --> AudioError : Audio problem
        ClassifyError --> FatalError : Critical failure

        TransientError --> RetryWithBackoff : Attempt retry
        RetryWithBackoff --> RecoverySuccessful : Fixed
        RetryWithBackoff --> EscalateError : Still failing

        ServiceError --> DegradedMode : Activate fallback
        AudioError --> AudioRecovery : Reinitialize audio

        EscalateError --> FatalError : Too many failures
    }

    ErrorRecovery --> PassiveListening : RecoverySuccessful
    ErrorRecovery --> AudioInit : AudioRecovery
    ErrorRecovery --> PassiveListening : DegradedMode
    ErrorRecovery --> Disabled : FatalError
```
-->
-->

**Recovery Strategies:**

- Transient → Exponential backoff
- Service → Degraded mode
- Audio → Reinitialize
- Fatal → Clean shutdown

**Escalation:**

- 3 failures → Escalate
- 5 failures → Fatal

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#72-state-transition-summary-table]

### 7.2 State Transition Summary Table

| From State            | To State          | Trigger            | Notes                   |
| --------------------- | ----------------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- |
| **Disabled**          | Audio Init        | User clicks Enable | Only exit from disabled |
| **Audio Init**        | Passive Listening | Setup successful   | Happy path              |
| **Audio Init**        | Disabled          | Setup failed       | Fallback to text-only   |
| **Passive Listening** | Active Listening  | Wake word detected | "Aria" recognized       |
| **Passive Listening** | Disabled          | User disables      | Manual stop             |
| **Active Listening**  | Command Execution | Command received   | Valid command parsed    |
| **Active Listening**  | Passive Listening | Timeout or invalid | Return to monitoring    |
| **Command Execution** | Passive Listening | Task complete      | Ready for next command  |
| **Command Execution** | Disabled          | Disable command    | "Turn off voice"        |
| **Any State**         | Error Recovery    | Service failure    | Automatic recovery      |
| **Error Recovery**    | Original State    | Recovery success   | Resume operation        |
| **Error Recovery**    | Disabled          | Fatal error        | Safe shutdown           |

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#1--disabled-state]

#### 1. 🚫 Disabled State

- **Entry**: System start, user disables interactive mode, or fatal error
- **Behavior**: No voice recognition active, all audio resources released
- **Recovery**: Manual re-enable or system restart
- **Safety**: Guaranteed clean state with no resource leaks
page_texts.39:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#2--audio-initialization-state]

#### 2. 🔧 Audio Initialization State

- **Entry**: User enables interactive mode
- **Behavior**:
  - Requests microphone permissions with user-friendly prompts
  - Validates browser compatibility and feature availability
  - Initializes Web Audio API context with error handling
  - Tests speech recognition availability
- **Resilience**:
  - Graceful degradation to text-only mode if audio fails
  - Clear user feedback for permission issues
  - Fallback strategies for unsupported browsers
- **Exit**: Audio ready or fallback to text mode
page_texts.40:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#3--passive-listening-state]

#### 3. 🏁 Passive Listening State

- **Entry**: Audio initialization successful
- **Behavior**:
  - Continuous wake word monitoring with confidence scoring
  - Heartbeat monitoring to detect system health issues
  - False positive filtering to reduce accidental activations
  - Resource monitoring to prevent memory leaks
- **Resilience**:
  - Automatic recovery from recognition service disruptions
  - Confidence threshold tuning to adapt to user's voice
  - Periodic health checks with automatic restart if needed
  - Graceful handling of network connectivity issues
- **Audio**: Subtle confirmation beep on successful activation
- **Visual**: Clear indicators showing listening status
page_texts.41:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#4--active-listening-state]

#### 4. 🎙️ Active Listening State

- **Entry**: Wake word validated with sufficient confidence
- **Behavior**:
  - Real-time transcription with confidence scoring
  - Intelligent timeout management based on speech patterns
  - Command classification and intent recognition
  - Ambiguity resolution with user confirmation
- **Resilience**:
  - Multiple timeout strategies (silence, partial speech, complete command)
  - Retry mechanisms for unclear commands
  - Fallback to text clarification if speech fails repeatedly
  - Context preservation for command continuation
- **Error Handling**:
  - Recognition errors trigger controlled fallback
  - Network issues handled with local caching
  - Service failures activate degraded mode operation
page_texts.42:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#5--command-execution-state]

#### 5. 🔍 Command Execution State

- **Entry**: Valid command identified and classified
- **Behavior**:
  - Command routing based on type (search, system, control)
  - Parameter extraction and validation
  - Security checks for sensitive operations
  - Progress tracking with user feedback
- **Resilience**:
  - Search timeouts handled gracefully with partial results
  - Service failures trigger alternative approaches
  - Command queuing for temporary service outages
  - Transaction-like behavior with rollback capability
- **Sub-states**:
  - **Search Processing**: RAG service calls with retry logic
  - **TTS Playback**: Interruptible speech with quality fallbacks
  - **System Commands**: Validated execution with audit logging
page_texts.43:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#6--error-recovery-state]

#### 6. 🛠️ Error Recovery State

- **Entry**: Any unrecoverable error from other states
- **Behavior**:
  - Error classification and severity assessment
  - Automated recovery strategies based on error type
  - Resource cleanup and state validation
  - User communication about system status
- **Recovery Strategies**:
  - **Transient Errors**: Exponential backoff retry
  - **Service Errors**: Degraded mode with alternative methods
  - **Audio Errors**: Fallback to text-based interaction
  - **Fatal Errors**: Controlled shutdown with user notification
- **Resilience Features**:
  - State restoration from last known good configuration
  - Progressive degradation maintaining core functionality
  - Automatic escalation for persistent issues
  - User-initiated emergency stops
  - `"disable interactive mode"` → Disabled
  - `"list commands"` → TTS response → Initial Enablement
- **Exit**: Command complete
page_texts.44:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/speech_interface_design.md#6--interruption-overlay-substate]

#### 6. 🔇 Interruption Overlay (Substate)

- **Entry**: TTS starts speaking (overlay on main state)
- **Behavior**:
  - Active during speech synthesis
  - Can detect wake words to interrupt speech
  - Can execute stop commands ("stop", "quiet", "enough")
- **Exit**: TTS ends or gets interrupted

### Component Loading Strategy

The modular architecture uses a specific loading sequence to ensure proper dependency resolution:

```html
<!-- Browser compatibility detection (loaded first) -->
<script src="search-browser-detection.js"></script>

<!-- Core component modules -->
<script src="search-audio-manager.js"></script>
<script src="search-voice-recognition.js"></script>
<script src="search-state-machine.js"></script>
<script src="search-interface.js"></script>

<!-- Central orchestrator (loaded last) -->
<script src="search-orchestrator.js"></script>
```
